description: Source code for managing ClawHub skills, including installation, update, lockfile handling, and fingerprinting.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedSlug
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a tracked skill slug.

methods.name: validateRequestedSlug
methods.description: Validates a requested skill slug against pattern and ASCII constraints.

methods.name: resolveRequestedUpdateSlug
methods.description: Resolves the slug to be updated, considering lockfile and origin.

methods.name: resolveSkillInstallDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for skill installation based on workspace and slug.

methods.name: ensureSkillRoot
methods.description: Ensures the skill root directory contains a valid SKILL.md file.

methods.name: readClawHubSkillsLockfile
methods.description: Reads the lockfile containing installed skills information.

methods.name: writeClawHubSkillsLockfile
methods.description: Writes the current skills lockfile to disk.

methods.name: readClawHubSkillOrigin
methods.description: Reads the origin metadata of a skill from its directory.

methods.name: writeClawHubSkillOrigin
methods.description: Writes origin metadata for a skill.

methods.name: searchSkillsFromClawHub
methods.description: Searches for skills on ClawHub based on query parameters.

methods.name: resolveInstallVersion
methods.description: Resolves the specific version and detail info for a skill to install.

methods.name: installExtractedSkill
methods.description: Installs a skill from an extracted archive directory.

methods.name: performClawHubSkillInstall
methods.description: Performs the full process of installing a skill from ClawHub.

methods.name: installRequestedSkillFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a skill based on a requested slug, validating it first.

methods.name: installTrackedSkillFromClawHub
methods.description: Installs a tracked skill, normalizing its slug.

methods.name: resolveTrackedUpdateTarget
methods.description: Resolves the update target for a tracked skill, considering origin and lockfile.

methods.name: installSkillFromClawHub
methods.description: Public API to install a skill from ClawHub.

methods.name: updateSkillsFromClawHub
methods.description: Updates all or specific skills from ClawHub.

methods.name: readTrackedClawHubSkillSlugs
methods.description: Reads all tracked ClawHub skill slugs from lockfile.

methods.name: computeSkillFingerprint
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 fingerprint of a skill directory based on its files.
